query: SELECT m.conversation_id, m.name, m.workspace, t.channel_id, GREATEST((SELECT MIN(e.created_at) FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND e.lifecycle IN ('run.started', 'run.resumed')), (SELECT MAX(a.created_at) FROM channel_messages a WHERE a.channel_id = t.channel_id AND a.type = 'assign' AND a.to_conversation = m.conversation_id), (SELECT MAX(r.created_at) FROM channel_messages r WHERE r.channel_id = t.channel_id AND r.type = 'report' AND r.author_kind = 'conversation' AND r.author_id = m.conversation_id::text)) AS since , EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND e.lifecycle IN ('run.started', 'run.resumed')) AS "started!" FROM agent_team_members m JOIN agent_teams t ON t.id = m.team_id WHERE m.team_id = $1 AND m.conversation_id = ANY($2) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages r WHERE r.channel_id = t.channel_id AND r.type = 'report' AND r.author_id = m.conversation_id::text AND r.seq > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(a.seq) FROM channel_messages a WHERE a.channel_id = t.channel_id AND a.type = 'assign' AND a.to_conversation = m.conversation_id), 0)) ORDER BY m.name
